card.name: Part numbers and cross-reference punctuation
card.fires_on: Digits inside catalog or part numbers, and the bracket or 'and' joining section titles or checks (e.g. 'Storage', 'particulate matter and') in drug-label preparation and cross-reference text.

modes.label: Part number digits
modes.description: Characters of a product part number or tubing size in preparation materials lists.

modes.label: Section cross-reference
modes.description: Opening parenthesis or period in a section number after a section title like Clinical Pharmacology.
modes.example: Use in Specific Populations ( 8.6 ), Clinical Pharmacology<< (>> 12.3 )] .

modes.label: And between inspection or storage terms
modes.description: The word 'and' joining paired terms in headings or inspection instructions.

card.writes: Promotes words like diluted, solution (Russian) and oral, and suppresses voltage and circuit terms, so it favors medicine-preparation wording over electrical wording.
card.plain: It fires on small bits of label text such as part numbers, section references and the 'and' in preparation steps.
